name: apache-superset
description: Apache Superset (6.x) on the data platform: Kubernetes deployment (Stackable/Helm), Keycloak OIDC + role mapping, RLS and multi-tenant embedding with guest tokens, dashboards-as-code (superset-cli sync, GitOps), dataset/semantic-layer design over Trino/ClickHouse/Iceberg, caching/async performance, dashboard design and lifecycle (Few, Knaflic, Tufte, Wexler, Kirk, Desbarats), chart selection and verified chart-API limits, colour accessibility, privacy compliance, AI layer (governed MCP, NL2SQL), Superset internals, Extensions and MCP; v0.3 adds the testing layer: Superset-as-component test strategy (static/unit/contract/integration/E2E/performance/visual/security/upgrade mapped to qa-test-strategy ids), a disposable test harness (compose/Testcontainers with Trino, Keycloak, Mailpit; API client, seeding, guest-token minting) and upgrade regression
